notes: Added missing schema, rotation engine, and audit logging coverage to complete lifecycle.

stories.title: Token Metadata Schema Definition
stories.description: Define and implement the persistent schema for bearer tokens including fields for token_id, hashed_token, issued_at, expires_at, rotation_version, revoked_flag, and audit metadata. Ensure compatibility with existing GPTReader and Brain auth flows.

stories.title: Token Rotation Engine
stories.description: Implement backend logic to rotate bearer tokens based on policy (time-based or usage-based), issuing new tokens while invalidating prior versions according to rotation rules without service interruption.
stories.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py; GAP: No rotation mechanism currently implemented

stories.title: Token Expiration Policy Enforcement
stories.description: Implement configurable expiration rules for bearer tokens, enforcing TTL validation during authentication and ensuring expired tokens are rejected even if not yet rotated or revoked.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Audit Logging
stories.description: Extend logging to capture token issuance, rotation, expiration, validation failures, and revocation events with traceability to request context for security auditing.
